settings.title: Consult
settings.text: Share your space, size and ideas. We talk through shape, material, colour and budget, on WhatsApp or a virtual appointment.

settings.title: Sample (if required)
settings.text: Where it helps, we make a small sample so you can check colour, texture and pile before the full rug is made.

settings.title: Make
settings.text: Once you approve, your rug is made to order and delivered to you.

settings.intro: A rug made for your space: your size, your shape, your palette. Tell us what you have in mind and we will take it from there.
settings.form_intro: Share as much or as little as you know. Only your contact details are required.
